PROMPT: 

Act as a Senior Infographic Designer and Editorial Art Director. Create ONE premium, high-resolution educational infographic featuring a colorful Flat Vector Editorial Infographic style with layered paper-cut illustrations, bold typography, and an engaging visual storytelling layout.

1. INFOGRAPHIC DETAILS

Topic: [INSERT TOPIC]

Main Headline: [INSERT HEADLINE]

Target Audience: [INSERT AUDIENCE]

Language: [INSERT LANGUAGE]

Aspect Ratio: [3:4 / 4:5 / A4 Portrait]

Main Visual: [INSERT SUBJECT / AUTO-SELECT]

Purpose: [EDUCATION / AWARENESS / EDUTAINMENT]

2. INFOGRAPHIC CONTENT

Use the following information accurately and organize it clearly in the infographic.

Section 1 — [HEADING]

[INSERT CONTENT]

Note: Add more sections or information accordingly based on the topic and content needs.

3. VISUAL STYLE

Colorful 2D flat vector illustrations with clean geometric shapes.

Layered paper-cut elements, subtle drop shadows, and soft dimensional depth.

Friendly, playful, slightly retro educational editorial aesthetic.

A large central illustration representing the main topic.

Small supporting icons, objects, arrows, and thematic illustrations distributed around the central visual.

Clean vector edges, solid color fills, and minimal texture.

Visually rich and engaging without looking cluttered.

4. LAYOUT & COMPOSITION

Create a vertical, free-flowing editorial composition, not a rigid card-based grid.

Place a prominent headline inside a contrasting full-width top banner.

Position the dominant illustration near the center, occupying approximately 35–45% of the main visual area.

Arrange information organically around the central illustration using varied text sizes and supporting icons.

Use overlapping vector elements to connect sections and guide reading flow.

Incorporate contrasting background color zones to separate information naturally.

Maintain strong visual hierarchy, balanced spacing, and readable text.

5. COLOR & TYPOGRAPHY

Suggested Palette:

Mustard Yellow #F2BD22

Deep Ocean Blue #185093

Turquoise #16A69F

Warm Cream #E8E5DA

Coral Red #D94332

Earth Green #65845A

Adapt colors to match the topic while preserving a cohesive, vibrant educational aesthetic.

Typography:

Bold sans-serif uppercase headings.

Large, highly visible numbers and statistics.

Clear, compact supporting text.

Strong contrast between text and background.

Varied font weights and sizes for editorial hierarchy.

6. DESIGN RULES

Prioritize visual storytelling over long paragraphs.

Use topic-relevant illustrations, not generic decorative icons.

Keep each explanation concise, preferably 1–2 short sentences.

Integrate text and illustrations naturally without unnecessary boxes.

Preserve all supplied facts, figures, and wording accurately.

Do not invent statistics or unsupported claims.

Ensure spelling, legibility, and consistent illustration quality.

Avoid photorealism, 3D rendering, excessive gradients, and corporate dashboard layouts.

7. FINAL GENERATION

Generate ONE complete, high-resolution vertical infographic, ready for digital sharing or printing.

The finished design must feature a bold headline banner, an eye-catching central illustration, layered flat-vector elements, clear educational sections, vibrant contrasting color zones, and professional editorial typography.

Generate the finished infographic image, not a mockup.

Paparkan kemajuan kuiz, jumlah soalan, skor dan baki nyawa sepanjang permainan. Sediakan halaman utama, butang mula, soalan seterusnya, ulang semula dan halaman keputusan akhir yang memaparkan jumlah jawapan betul, salah, markah serta pencapaian murid. Gunakan reka bentuk permainan pendidikan moden, ceria, berwarna-warni dan responsif untuk telefon pintar serta komputer. Pastikan semua soalan, jawapan, pengiraan markah, pemasa dan butang benar-benar berfungsi. Hasilkan keseluruhan permainan dalam satu fail HTML yang boleh dimainkan secara offline tanpa library atau fail luaran."

caption.text:
JANGAN sekadar minta Gemini Notebook aka NotebookLM untuk “buat video tentang [TOPIK]”. 

Ini saya share 5 prompt video pembelajaran yang korang boleh cuba hari ini.

fragments.plaintext:
1. Video Pengenalan Topik
Sesuai digunakan sebelum pelajar mula belajar sesuatu topik.

Prompt:
“ Create an introductory learning video about [TOPIC]. Give students a clear big-picture overview before they learn the topic in detail. Introduce the main concepts, explain why the topic is important, provide simple examples, and highlight what students should understand by the end of the video. Use language suitable for [EDUCATION LEVEL].”

caption.text:
1. Video Pengenalan Topik

Prompt:

Introduce the main concepts, explain why the topic is important, provide simple examples, and highlight what students should understand by the end of the video. Use language suitable for [EDUCATION LEVEL].”

fragments.plaintext:
2. Video Penerangan Konsep
Sesuai untuk menerangkan konsep yang susah dengan cara lebih mudah.

Prompt:
“ Create an educational video explaining [CONCEPT]. Start with a simple definition, then explain the concept step-by-step. Use relatable examples and analogies to make difficult ideas easier to understand. Highlight common misunderstandings and end with the key points students should remember. Use language suitable for [EDUCATION LEVEL].”

fragments.plaintext:
3. Video Proses
Sesuai untuk topik yang mempunyai proses, urutan atau beberapa peringkat.

Prompt:
“ Create a step-by-step learning video explaining how [PROCESS] works. Begin with a short introduction, then explain each stage in the correct sequence. Clearly show how one step leads to the next and explain why each step is important. End with a short recap of the complete process. Use language suitable for [EDUCATION LEVEL].”
